name: zombie_rider.live_natural_evolution_mcw
description: Native natural evolution: a substantially old-world hostile predator is allowed to follow the configured GROUP_ZOMBIE_PREDATOR_UPGRADE path until rider generation while sealed inside an audited impassable concrete ring, with no rider or ammo setup injection.

steps.label: settle_natural_predator_footing
steps.expected_visible_fact: tagged hostile predator loads in the substantially old world

steps.label: audit_old_world_age_and_season_length
steps.abort_reason: fixture did not prove the substantially old world footing
steps.expected_visible_fact: saved turn proves the substantially old world setup; season length is retained in the source-bound fixture and native diagnostic evidence

steps.label: audit_sealed_hunter_ring
steps.abort_reason: saved map did not prove every tile of the impassable hunter ring
steps.expected_visible_fact: all eight ring tiles around the hunter are t_concrete_wall

steps.label: audit_single_natural_predator_actor
steps.abort_reason: saved active_monsters did not prove the tagged predator

steps.label: operate_native_natural_predator_evolution
steps.objective: Use only advertised native wait and movement actions. Let the substantially old predator perform ordinary overdue on-load half-life rolls through GROUP_ZOMBIE_PREDATOR_UPGRADE until the production path generates the rider. Record actor identity, group choice, world age, exactly-once rider ammo initialization, and the first divergence.
invariants: no rider debug spawn or poly

steps.label: save_and_close_natural_evolution_run
steps.objective: Use the advertised native save-and-quit path and finish the owned run with cleanup.

steps.label: audit_natural_rider_generation
steps.abort_reason: native production path did not generate exactly one rider with the configured group and ammo initialization

evidence_contract.claim: one current-worktree native mature hunter naturally upgrades through the configured predator group into one rider with exactly-once ammo initialization
evidence_contract.setup_guard: fixture hunter placement earns no behavior credit
evidence_contract.writeback_note: native save/load is required if the rider is generated before the terminal boundary
